ai_summary: This document confirms Aditya Birla Capital Limited's compliance with SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with its RTA certifying proper processing of 43,137 dematerialization requests and no rematerializations. This demonstrates robust adherence to regulatory requirements and efficient investor services, with 99.75% of the company's total paid-up equity capital now in dematerialized form. No red flags or material negative impacts are identified.
